summary: Iteration 3 focused regression after code-quality refactors. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests pass (17 existing + 4 new for JWT_SECRET empty placeholder & async export-job flow incl. AI codegen path). Frontend: verified Builder chat renders with stable ids (no duplicate/misordered messages) + skip-to-builder generates starter circuit + Export button present; Monitor save & probe shows cyan LIVE badge with real latency (~129.5ms to example.com) while other nodes stay simulated, interval switching + live/pause toggle work; Analyzer github analyze -> drawer (detail-endpoints + drill) -> drill-down subgraph -> back -> Open in Builder loads 5 nodes on /builder. No behavior regressions detected from the refactors.

minor.issue: Legacy sync AI export still exceeds public-ingress ~60s and returns 502; the new async /builder/export-job path is the intended replacement and works end-to-end via the public URL (verified via localhost for the AI variant to save time).
Still accept raw dict payloads (no Pydantic schema). Carried over from iter1/iter2.

action_items: Consider removing or deprecating the sync /api/builder/export?ai=true path (superseded by /builder/export-job); or route the AI flag to enqueue a job automatically to avoid confusion.
Add Pydantic models for /builder/export-job, /builder/validate, /projects/{id}/monitor/config payloads to fail fast on bad shapes.
critical_code_review_comments: EXPORT_JOBS is an in-memory dict (server.py) — jobs will be lost on backend restart and don't scale across replicas. Acceptable for single-node dev, but flag as limitation.
builder_service._be_env now emits JWT_SECRET="" + openssl comment — good. Consider also emitting a runtime check in the scaffold that raises if JWT_SECRET is empty, so downstream apps fail fast.
MonitorPage.jsx poll() reorder is safe; console.error catches added — reasonable. Suggest exposing a subtle UI error indicator when polls repeatedly fail (currently silently logs).
ChatOnboarding now uses stable m.id keys — no duplicates observed in stream; good.
seed_data_creation: Re-analyzed expressjs/express (structural) for the analyzer regression. Set monitor config n_client -> https://example.com on expressjs/express project (live probe verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration3.py covers the new async /builder/export-job endpoints and the JWT_SECRET="" placeholder in scaffold backend/.env.example. AI codegen job flow (~150s) is tested against localhost:8001 to avoid ingress 60s cap; through the public ingress the POST /builder/export-job returns fast (job id) and the GET /export-job/{id}/download is small, so it works end-to-end through ingress in real use.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
